answer_1.quote: we employ a one-shot prompt with GPT-4 to generate a detailed difference caption with metadata
answer_1.outputs: Difference captions describing changes between original and edited images

answer_2.quote: We propose two novel evaluation metrics tailored for all differences caption comparisons: Model Precision (MP) and Hallucination Rate (HR).

answer_3.quote: A match between two DTs is determined if the edit action types are identical, and the source and target objects are similar, as evaluated by GPT-4o.

answer_4.quote: We employed Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) to evaluate image edits using human annotators... with three annotations per edit.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assess edits based on Accuracy Level, Artifacts Level, Technical Precision, Visual Consistency, and Difference Caption Accuracy, using decision trees for guidance.
